items.heading: Ncahp Originally Proposed Making NEET
items.text: NCAHP originally proposed making NEET-UG the common entrance exam for BPT and BOT (Bachelor of Occupational Therapy) admissions starting the 2026-27 academic year.

items.heading: After Pushback From Institutions, Students,
items.text: After pushback from institutions, students, and professional bodies including the Indian Association of Physiotherapists, NCAHP deferred the NEET-mandatory requirement to the 2027-28 academic year.

items.heading: For the 2026
items.text: For the 2026-27 admission cycle, most institutions are admitting through a merit list based on aggregate Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, and Biology marks (commonly a minimum 50% aggregate), not NEET scores.
